verdict.rationale: Expensify documents user-buildable rules: workspaces and rules can be configured by asking the AI. It also documents event-driven automations such as auto-export of finalized reports, scheduled report submission, and policy-based auto-categorization. However, the evidence does not describe a general rule engine where users define arbitrary event triggers and actions. missing for 10: documented trigger/condition/action rule configuration, a list of supported events and actions, independent hands-on corroboration of custom rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Configure workspaces, build rules, and fix your own setup mistakes by just asking
Automatically create, submit, approve, and reimburse expenses. Reports automatically sync with accounting.
Automatically submits reports based on your timeline
Finalized reports are exported automatically to QuickBooks Online.
Expensify uses your policies and past behavior to auto-categorize expenses as they're created.
